D: A poor boy finds a golden ticket and tours a mysterious chocolate factory.
P: Serve the drinks when Charlie and Grandpa Joe sneak a taste of the fizzy lifting drinks.
S: White chocolate cups filled with vanilla whipped cream, with a chocolate handle
White chocolate set inside small paper cups, peeled, filled with a vanilla mousse, a chocolate handle stuck on the side. Eat the whole thing.
Veruca wants a goose that lays golden eggs, now

Dark chocolate egg shells filled with salted caramel ganache, joined and brushed with edible gold lustre until they shine like golden eggs. Melt 300g dark chocolate gently and brush into 16 half-egg moulds in two coats, chilling between, then set. Heat 80ml cream and pour over 100g chopped milk chocolate, then stir in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt and cool until thick. Fill the shells, warm the rims on a hot tray and press halves together. Chill, unmould and brush with edible gold lustre.
Seeded crackers with whipped ricotta and crushed raspberries, blackberries, blueberries
Seeded crackers spread with whipped ricotta and topped with a mix of raspberries, blackberries and blueberries crushed with a little sugar.
M: Beef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley braised 3 hours, with bread
Beef shin browned, onion, carrot and potato softened, pearl barley and stock added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Bread to stretch it further.
the room where everything, even the grass, is edible

A big board planted like a garden: toasted marshmallow mushrooms on pretzel stalks, chocolate strawberries, toffee apple wedges, honeycomb rocks and a fairy floss cloud. Melt 200g dark chocolate. Dip 250g strawberries halfway and set on baking paper. Push pretzel sticks into 12 large marshmallows, toast the tops with a blowtorch or under the grill and dip the bases in chocolate. Cut 2 apples into wedges, toss in lemon juice and drizzle with 3 tbsp warm caramel. Break 150g honeycomb into rocks. Arrange on a board with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and fairy floss in the middle.
W: Cherries wrapped in white then dark ganache, rolled in cocoa and sprinkles
Layered truffles: a cherry centre wrapped in white chocolate ganache, chilled, then dark ganache, chilled, then rolled in cocoa and coloured sugar so every bite shows a new layer.
K: Raspberry and lemon with soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet
Raspberry purée and lemon syrup in a tall glass, topped with very cold soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up to the rim.

note.text: Do not rush. The Everlasting Gobstopper never runs out, although you might. Mind the fizzy bubbles, and do not burp.

winks: Fizzy lifting drinks and the ceiling fan
Grandpa Joe leaping out of bed
The boat ride through the tunnel

dishes.make_ahead: Make the cups a day ahead, fill just before serving

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate and brush two coats inside small paper cups, setting between coats.
Chill until firm, then peel off the paper.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar and vanilla seeds and fill the cups.
Pipe dark chocolate handles and stick them on. Eat the whole thing.
Crush the berries with the sugar using a spoon.
Whip the ricotta until smooth.
Spread on the crackers and top with the berries. Taste them and decide what a snozzberry is.
Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions, then add the carrots, potatoes, pearl barley and stock.
Cover and braise at 160C until thick and tender.
Serve with bread to stretch it further.
Heat part of the cream and pour over the white chocolate to make ganache.
Chill until firm enough to handle.
Wrap each drained cherry in white ganache and chill again.
Heat the rest of the cream, pour over the dark chocolate and cool to a dark ganache.
Wrap the white balls in dark ganache and chill.
Roll in cocoa and coloured sugar. Bite to see the layers.
Blitz the raspberries and strain.
Mix with the lemon juice and sugar syrup and divide between four tall glasses.
Top with very cold soda water and drop in a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up. Don't burp.

s.note: White chocolate cups filled with vanilla whipped cream, with a chocolate handle
s.how: Brush 200g melted white chocolate inside 8 small paper cups in two coats and set. Peel off the paper. Whip 200ml cream with icing sugar and vanilla bean seeds and fill. Stick on a piped dark chocolate handle. Eat the whole thing.

s.note: Seeded crackers with whipped ricotta and crushed raspberries, blackberries, blueberries
s.how: Crush 100g raspberries, 100g blackberries and 100g blueberries with a spoon of sugar. Spread 16 seeded crackers with 200g whipped ricotta and top with the berries. Taste them and decide what a snozzberry is.

m.note: Beef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley braised 3 hours, with bread
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef shin. Soften 2 onions, 3 carrots and 400g potatoes, add 100g pearl barley and 1.2L stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Serve with bread to stretch it further.

w.note: Cherries wrapped in white then dark ganache, rolled in cocoa and sprinkles
w.how: Wrap 12 maraschino cherries in white ganache made from 150g white chocolate and 50ml cream, and chill. Wrap again in dark ganache from 150g dark chocolate and 75ml cream, and chill. Roll in cocoa and coloured sugar. Bite to see the layers.

d.note: Raspberry and lemon with soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet
d.how: Blitz 150g raspberries and strain. Mix with the juice of 2 lemons and 2 tbsp sugar syrup. Divide between four tall glasses, top with very cold soda water and drop in a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up. Don't burp.
